items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] There was Freddie Scott and Symphonics. Their big hit was 'Come On Honey.' [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah.

ctx.x: No, we were -- we started -- We just moved back. We moved out then I moved back to 1697. We only been two places. We moved out of 1697. Then I went out on the road in '56. In 1956, I think I moved the publishing company over to 1674 because I went to -- right after that, I went on the road with that 'Walking The Blues' thing. I was out there for a year. And I came back and I reopened -- but I reopened in 1674 Broadway.
All right. So, the Enrica Records had some of the groups that was -- There was Freddie Scott and Symphonics. Their big hit was 'Come On Honey.'
